era: DS / Wii / HD farming action RPG
summary: Marvelous's fantasy life-sim action RPG series, born from Story of Seasons/Harvest Moon and expanded across handheld, console, and PC releases.

entries.title: Rune Factory: A Fantasy Harvest Moon

emulation.notes: Use legal cartridge dumps and a stable dual-screen capture layout.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native DS rendering with clean scaling.

primary.version: Original Nintendo DS release via melonDS
primary.why: The first Rune Factory only released on Nintendo DS, so DS emulation is the cleanest capture route for the complete original.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally dumped DS cartridge image in melonDS with a readable dual-screen layout, or play on original DS/3DS hardware.

all_releases.fidelity: Only release of the first game.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole platform and complete route; DS emulation improves capture readability.

entries.title: Rune Factory 3: A Fantasy Harvest Moon

primary.how_to_play: Play Rune Factory 3 Special on Steam. Use the Digital Deluxe content only if you want its cosmetic swimsuit mode active.
